title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. This looks good and is comfortable, but gets hot and collects lots of static electricity [and I have old school radiators, not dry heat.]  I think the worst thing, however, is that with no straps or ways to attach it to the sofa, it slides and slips off constantly.  If you are buying this to cover and ugly couch that no one uses regularly, then buy it - otherwise, this gets a D in my grade book and I wouldn't recommend it.
